items.title: Charlie Love Interview, 1958-06-19, 20
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] The violin? Wasn't he with Handy once too? [INTERVIEWEE] Oh yeah he played with Handy...

ctx.x: The violin? Wasn't he with Handy once too?
Oh yeah he played with Handy and his brother was a violin player too. He was good but he was a big gambler.
How do you spell his name? Paul? Do you remember Paul's last name? Paul. Wasn't it?
